title: Professional Changes and New Beginnings
summary: Career change, dissatisfaction, proposals, and fresh starts.
whyItMatters: Career-change language helps you describe a previous situation, explain motivation, identify transferable skills, and plan realistic next steps.

mentalModel.title: Past, reason, next step
mentalModel.content: Describe what you did, why change became important, and what you plan to do now.

mentalModel.title: Separate problem from goal
mentalModel.content: Name the concrete difficulty and the condition you want in a new role.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe professional history
ruleBlocks.content: Use Ausbildung, Stelle, Aufgabe, Erfahrung, Branche, kündigen, wechseln, and sich bewerben.

ruleBlocks.title: Explain motivation specifically
ruleBlocks.content: Connect dissatisfaction to workload, development, schedule, values, pay, location, or responsibility.

ruleBlocks.title: Show transferable skills
ruleBlocks.content: Link a previous task to a capability useful in the new direction.

examples.de: Früher arbeitete ich im Verkauf, aber die Arbeitszeiten waren schwierig.
examples.en: I used to work in retail, but the working hours were difficult.

examples.de: Durch meine Kundenarbeit kann ich gut erklären und organisieren.
examples.en: Through my customer work I can explain and organize well.

examples.de: Jetzt möchte ich eine Weiterbildung machen und mich neu bewerben.
examples.en: Now I want to complete further training and apply again.

commonMistakes.wrong: Say only that the old job was bad.
commonMistakes.correct: Name the specific problem and desired change.
commonMistakes.reason: Concrete motivation is clearer and more professional.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ignore useful prior experience during a change.
commonMistakes.reason: A new direction still builds on existing experience.

comparisons.summary: Past forms describe earlier roles and key events.
The communication lesson turns problems into constructive proposals.
